name: Add a plugin-provided Knowledge skill
query: My plugin currently stores a transcription prompt in an option. Move it to a WordPress Knowledge skill so the site agent and other clients can discover it, but do not overwrite edits after setup.
expected_behavior: Step 1: Run wordpress-router and wp-project-triage to classify the repo and locate the plugin entrypoint
Step 2: Route to wp-knowledge because the task mentions WordPress Knowledge storage and agent-discoverable skill storage
Step 3: Confirm that the target runtime exposes wp_knowledge, wp_knowledge_type, /wp/v2/knowledge, and the needed Knowledge capabilities
Step 4: Mention that current pre-Core usage requires Gutenberg 23.6+ with the Guidelines experiment active when the feature depends on that runtime
Step 5: Choose the skill type rather than guideline, memory, or note, registering or verifying the custom type if the runtime does not provide it
Step 6: Resolve or create the wp_knowledge_type term by slug and assign by term id
Step 7: Create or update a wp_knowledge post with stable slug, title, excerpt, content, status, author, and wp_knowledge_type terms
Step 8: Preserve user edits after setup by using an idempotent seeding strategy such as a plugin-specific seed hash
Step 9: Keep site-wide publish behavior behind an administrator-controlled setup path or explicit user intent
Step 10: Verify REST discovery and permission behavior for private/published rows
success_criteria: Does not introduce an alternate or compatibility backend
Stores the short discovery text in excerpt and full procedure in content
Does not clobber user-edited content on later runs
Respects Knowledge capabilities and per-post capability checks
Mentions graceful degradation when Knowledge is unavailable
